verdict.rationale: The evidence only touches the hosted-update-page part of this story. A Stripe-hosted customer portal lets customers manage their account, and a Stripe PM mentions credit card update notice emails (off by default), but neither says explicitly that customers update their card there. Smart Retries is retry logic, not card updating, so it does not count here. missing for 10: network account updater (automatic card refresh), backup/fallback payment methods, explicit documentation of the portal's payment-method update flow, independent corroboration.
